hero.headline: Your calmer routine starts with the shelf you already own.
hero.subheadline: Ritora reads your shelf, catches ingredient clashes, and turns the chaos into a calm morning and night plan shaped by your skin.
hero.imageAlt: An open medicine cabinet in warm light, shelves filled with real everyday skincare bottles from different brands.

problem.headline: Good products, still guessing.
problem.body: You own the right bottles and still wake up unsure what to layer or skip. Ritora gives you the decision layer that was missing.

problems.title: Shelf confusion
problems.body: You own great products and still guess each morning what to apply and what to skip.

problems.title: Silent ingredient stacking
problems.body: Strong actives pile up between cleansers, toners, and serums. Irritation shows up long before you spot the cause.

problems.title: Buying over building
problems.body: Most routines don't need another serum. They need structure, sequencing, and safer choices with what you already own.

privacy.headline: Your shelf stays yours.
privacy.body: Ritora is built in the EU with explicit consent and essential cookies only. The points below reflect safeguards already present in the product today.

points.title: GDPR from day one
points.body: Your data is stored and processed under European privacy law. No exceptions, no loopholes.

points.title: Essential cookies only
points.body: Authentication and preference cookies only. No ad tech, no social pixels, and no hidden trackers.

points.title: Sensitive context is opt-in
points.body: Location and profile context only help your guidance when you choose to provide them.

points.title: Verified account access
points.body: Email verification and secure sign-in flows help protect access to your routine and profile data.

howItWorks.headline: Three calm steps from shelf clutter to daily clarity.
howItWorks.illustrationTitle: From morning to night, on repeat
howItWorks.illustrationBody: Ritora treats your routine as a living cycle. Every step carries last night's actives forward into this morning, so your plan stays safe without you having to think about it.

steps.title: Tell Ritora about your skin
steps.body: Share your skin type, concerns, sensitivities, goals, and how involved you want your routine to be. Every answer shapes the guidance you get.

steps.title: Map what's already on your shelf
steps.body: Add the products you use today so Ritora can spot ingredient overlap, flag risky pairings, and tell you what's genuinely missing.

steps.title: Follow a calmer daily plan
steps.body: Wake up to clear morning and evening guidance. Safety rules come first, and everything else is tuned to your goals and your shelf.

features.headline: Everything you need to make calmer skincare decisions.
features.illustrationBody: Every recommendation passes through a deterministic safety layer before it meets your goals. No surprises, no clashing actives, no regret purchases.

featureItems.title: Your shelf comes first
featureItems.body: Guidance always begins with the products you already own, never with a shopping cart.

featureItems.title: Ingredient safety guardrails
featureItems.body: Conflict checks and overlap detection protect sensitive skin and take the guesswork out of stacking actives.

featureItems.title: Tuned to your skin
featureItems.body: Your goals, sensitivities, skin tone, age, and ethnicity all shape every recommendation you see.

featureItems.title: Private by default
featureItems.body: Explicit consent, careful data boundaries, and EU friendly handling. Built in from day one, never bolted on later.

featureItems.title: Learn in the open
featureItems.body: Open, searchable pages for the basics. Private, personal routines once you sign in.

featureItems.title: Calmer daily rituals
featureItems.body: A morning and night view that keeps your routine steady even on the busiest days.

differentiators.headline: Built for your whole routine, not one brand.

items.title: Every brand, not one ecosystem
items.body: Ritora works with anything you already own. No brand loyalty required, no upsells, no sponsored picks.

items.title: Your whole routine, not one product
items.body: Ingredient checks run across every bottle at once, so conflicts cannot hide between steps.

items.title: Your skin, your climate, your season
items.body: Guidance adapts to your ethnicity, the climate you live in, and the season you are in today.

items.title: Full body, not just your face
items.body: Body wash, shampoo, lip care, and hand cream are part of the plan, the same way your face is.

faq.headline: Built to earn your trust before it asks for it.

faqItems.question: Is Ritora a medical product?
faqItems.answer: No. Ritora helps you make safer daily routine choices with the products you already own. It does not diagnose, treat, or replace a dermatologist.

faqItems.question: Do I need to buy new products to use it well?
faqItems.answer: Not at all. Ritora starts with your shelf. It helps you get more out of the products you already own before it suggests anything new.

faqItems.question: Will it work for beginners?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Beginners and collectors overwhelmed by their own shelf are exactly who Ritora is built for. It's a simpler path to a routine that actually works.

faqItems.question: How is my data handled?
faqItems.answer: With care. Ritora runs on explicit consent, careful data boundaries, and secure authentication. EU friendly handling is built in from day one.

faqItems.question: Which languages are supported?
faqItems.answer: English and Swedish are available at launch. You can change your preferred language any time from the settings page.

finalCta.headline: Turn your shelf into a calmer daily routine.
finalCta.body: Create an account in under a minute, or log in to pick up where you left off. Your skin profile, preferences, and routine setup stay in one place.

footer.brandBlurb: Ritora helps you turn the products you already own into a calmer, safer daily routine.

sunPigment.pageDesc: Sun reaction matters more than skin tone. It shapes which actives are safe for you.
sunPigment.questionPhototype: After a full day outside, your skin usually:
sunPigment.whyPhototype: Phototype is the standard way clinicians describe sun reaction. It guides how aggressively Ritora can suggest actives.
sunPigment.questionPih: After a pimple heals, do dark marks linger?
sunPigment.whyPih: Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation makes irritation cost more. Ritora will pick gentler actives and emphasise sunscreen.
sunPigment.questionMelasma: Do you experience melasma or persistent dark patches?
sunPigment.whyMelasma: Melasma needs special handling. Ritora will avoid heat-triggering actives and lean on tinted sunscreens.
sunPigment.questionKeloid: Does your skin scar with raised marks (keloids)?
sunPigment.whyKeloid: Keloid-prone skin needs gentler exfoliation choices.
sunPigment.questionSunscreen: How often do you wear sunscreen?
sunPigment.whySunscreen: Daily sunscreen use lowers irritation risk and slows photoaging.
sunPigment.questionTolerance: How do most sunscreens feel on your skin?
sunPigment.whyTolerance: If sunscreens irritate you, Ritora will favour mineral filters and tinted finishes.
sunPigment.questionFilter: Which sunscreen filter do you prefer?
sunPigment.whyFilter: Mineral, chemical, and hybrid filters feel different on skin. Ritora will respect your preference.
sunPigment.questionFinish: Which sunscreen finish do you prefer?
sunPigment.whyFinish: Adherence is higher when textures match your preference.

reactions.pageDesc: List ingredients or products that have triggered reactions before. Ritora will avoid suggesting them.
reactions.fieldTriggerHint: If Ritora knows the ingredient, it'll link to your Shelf warnings.
reactions.fieldPatchTest: Confirmed by patch test or clinician

activeTolerance.pageDesc: Have you used these actives before? Ritora will start at the right strength.
activeTolerance.introHint: Tap each active to set your tolerance. Skip what you haven't tried.

lifestyle.pageDesc: Sleep, stress, water, diet. Some breakouts have non-product causes.
lifestyle.questionSleep: How much sleep do you get on average?
lifestyle.whySleep: Less than 6 hours raises cortisol and oil production. Ritora will note this in suggestions.
lifestyle.whyStress: Stress drives cortisol-related breakouts. Ritora will favour calming actives if stress is high.
lifestyle.questionWater: How much water do you drink daily?
lifestyle.whyWater: Hydration helps barrier function. Low intake may explain dehydrated skin.
lifestyle.questionDiet: Any of these in your diet often?
lifestyle.whyDiet: High sugar and dairy correlate with acne for some people. Ritora won't lecture, but will surface lifestyle hints.
lifestyle.whySmoking: Smoking accelerates skin aging. Ritora will weight antioxidants higher.
lifestyle.questionAlcohol: How often do you drink alcohol?
lifestyle.whyAlcohol: Alcohol dehydrates the skin. Ritora may suggest extra hydration steps.
lifestyle.questionSweat: Do you sweat a lot during exercise?
lifestyle.whySweat: Sweat-prone skin needs different cleansing strategies.
lifestyle.questionMask: Do you wear a mask often (e.g. work)?
lifestyle.whyMask: Mask wear can trigger maskne. Ritora will avoid heavy occlusives in mask zones.
lifestyle.whyShaving: Shaving affects barrier and exfoliation tolerance.
lifestyle.questionClimate: Which environmental conditions bother your skin?
lifestyle.whyClimate: Ritora will tailor occlusives and barrier care to your climate sensitivities.

hormonal.pageDesc: For people who get cyclical breakouts. Every question is optional.
hormonal.consentLede: This can reveal sensitive health information. Ritora only uses it to make cycle-aware suggestions safer and more relevant.
hormonal.consentAsk1: Whether breakouts follow a cycle pattern.
hormonal.consentAsk3: Optional hormone-related context such as contraception or menopause changes.
hormonal.consentSafety: You can skip any question and delete this data anytime. It is encrypted, never sold, and never used for advertising.
hormonal.consentPromptBody: Hormonal context is optional and sensitive, so Ritora asks separately before storing it.
hormonal.consentRequiredError: Please review consent before saving hormonal context.
hormonal.questionCyclePattern: How predictable is your cycle pattern?
hormonal.whyCyclePattern: Predictability helps Ritora avoid overfitting suggestions to a pattern that may not apply.
hormonal.whyBreakoutPattern: Timing helps Ritora suggest gentler support before expected flare windows.
hormonal.whyCycleRelated: If breakouts are cyclical, Ritora can treat them differently from product-triggered reactions.
hormonal.whyHormonalContraception: Hormonal contraception can change oiliness and breakout patterns for some people.
hormonal.questionMenopause: Are menopause or perimenopause changes affecting your skin?
hormonal.whyMenopause: Hormone shifts can change dryness, sensitivity, and breakout patterns.
hormonal.deleteConfirmBody: Removes cycle pattern, breakout timing, and hormone-related context. Withdraws hormonal-context consent. This can't be undone.
hormonal.footerHint: Save only what you are comfortable sharing.

medicalSafety.pageDesc: Helps Ritora avoid suggesting things your body shouldn't have. Every question is optional.
medicalSafety.consentActiveBody: Granted on {date}. Withdraw anytime in Settings · Privacy.
medicalSafety.consentDialogLede: This is sensitive data. Read what we'll ask, why, and how it's protected before you decide.
medicalSafety.consentDialogAsk1: Pregnancy or breastfeeding. Some ingredients aren't safe.
medicalSafety.consentDialogAsk2: Skin conditions like rosacea or eczema. Different routines work better.
medicalSafety.consentDialogAsk3: Medications affecting skin. Some interact with skincare.
medicalSafety.consentDialogAsk4: Recent procedures like peels or laser. Your skin barrier may need gentler care.
medicalSafety.consentDialogSafety: You can skip any question. You can delete this data anytime. If you skip, Ritora gives general suggestions instead.
medicalSafety.consentDialogProtection1: Encrypted at rest. Only Ritora's own AI suggestion engine reads it.
medicalSafety.consentDialogProtection2: Never sold. Never used for advertising. Never sent to third parties.
medicalSafety.consentDialogProtection3: Activity log available in Settings · Privacy.
medicalSafety.consentDialogPrivacyLink: Read the full Privacy Notice for Health Data
medicalSafety.questionPregnancy: Are you currently pregnant, breastfeeding, or trying to conceive?
medicalSafety.pregnancyNotApplicableHint: Auto-set based on your sex at birth.
medicalSafety.whyPregnancy: Some common ingredients aren't safe in pregnancy or breastfeeding. Examples: retinoids, high-strength salicylic acid, hydroquinone. Ritora will leave them out of your suggestions.
medicalSafety.questionConditions: Have any of these been diagnosed by a clinician?
medicalSafety.whyConditions: Conditions like rosacea react badly to common actives. Knowing your diagnoses lets Ritora bias toward gentler routines.
medicalSafety.questionMedications: Are you taking any of these?
medicalSafety.whyMedications: Some medications make skin extremely sensitive. Some cause photosensitivity, which changes sunscreen guidance.
medicalSafety.questionPhotosensitizingOther: I take other medications that may cause photosensitivity
medicalSafety.questionProcedures: Any procedures in the last 90 days?
medicalSafety.whyProcedures: Recent peels, lasers, or microneedling compromise the skin barrier. Ritora will downgrade routine intensity for the recovery window.
medicalSafety.questionDermCare: Are you currently under a dermatologist's care?
medicalSafety.whyDermCare: If you're under active treatment, your dermatologist's plan takes precedence.
medicalSafety.questionsAnsweredHint: You can leave the rest blank.
medicalSafety.deleteConfirmBody: Removes pregnancy status, conditions, medications, and recent procedures. Withdraws health-data consent. This can't be undone.

shapeTips.heading: Tips by container shape
shapeTips.rectangular: Box or rectangular — front and back, or the side with the most text.
shapeTips.cylindrical: Bottle, tube, or cylinder — take 3–4 overlapping photos while rotating around the body. Keep important text away from the edges; the curve distorts text there.
shapeTips.roundJar: Jar, sphere, or round — top or lid, plus 2–3 side sections rotating ~90° between shots.
shapeTips.pouch: Pouch or sachet — lay flat on a surface and take one photo per printed side.

site.description: Ritora turns the skincare products you already own into a calmer morning and evening routine, with ingredient safety checks and guidance shaped by your skin.

cookies.metadataDescription: Cookie notice foundations for the Ritora web experience.
cookies.title: Cookie foundations for Ritora
paragraphs: The product direction aims to keep cookie use minimal and transparent. Authentication cookies and carefully scoped preference cookies are preferred over unnecessary tracking.
A fuller cookie notice will document what is essential, what is optional, and how user consent affects analytics or preference storage as more features ship.

privacy.metadataDescription: Privacy foundations for the Ritora web experience.
privacy.title: Privacy foundations for Ritora
paragraphs: Ritora is being built with privacy-by-design principles from the start. The product direction prioritizes data minimization, clear consent, and a boundary between public education features and private personalized routines.
As implementation expands, this page will be replaced with a full policy that documents lawful basis, retention periods, processor relationships, and export and deletion rights in more detail.
For now, this page establishes the intent behind the current technical improvements: secure auth foundations, explicit consent versioning, and a privacy-aware backend baseline.

terms.metadataDescription: Terms foundations for the Ritora web experience.
terms.title: Terms foundations for Ritora
paragraphs: Ritora is intended as a skincare decision-support experience, not a diagnostic or medical tool. The platform direction focuses on safer routine decisions, inventory clarity, and calmer product use.
As the product matures, these terms will be expanded to cover account responsibilities, acceptable use, disclaimer language, and service boundaries in production detail.
The current page exists so the public experience already has a real legal route structure instead of placeholder links.

settingsNotifications.reactionAlertsBody: Notify me when AI flags a possible reaction

settingsNotifications.todaysSuggestionBody: Three reminder kinds tied to each scheduled slot. Together they keep your routine on track without becoming noisy.
settingsNotifications.suggestionReadyBody: When a slot's suggestion becomes visible, your lead time before the scheduled time.
settingsNotifications.slotStartBody: At the scheduled time, so you remember to apply your routine.
settingsNotifications.recordingReminderBody: 30 minutes after the slot if no record yet. Quiet at night, retried at the next slot the following morning.

notificationsPage.title: Notifications
notificationsPage.subtitle: Suggestions, reminders, reactions, insights, and your Skin Wrapped, all in one place.
notificationsPage.emptyBody: When something needs your attention, like a possible reaction, a new insight, or your monthly Skin Wrapped, it will show up here.

errors.loadBody: Please try again. Your notification preferences and journal data are unchanged.

photo_reminder.title: Time for today's photo
photo_reminder.body: Capture your morning baseline in natural daylight.

reaction_detected.title: Possible reaction detected
reaction_detected.body: Increased redness, new breakouts. Routine simplified to barrier-repair until you acknowledge.

simplification_started.title: Routine simplified
simplification_started.body: Barrier repair mode active. Restore any time.

doctor_referral.title: Doctor referral nudge
doctor_referral.body: Persistent reaction signals. Consider a dermatologist visit.

wrapped_ready.title: Your Wrapped is ready
wrapped_ready.body: Your private recap is ready with AI captions on visible changes.

analysis_failed.title: Analysis failed
analysis_failed.body: Tap to retry on the entry.

suggestion_ready.title: Your suggestion is ready
suggestion_ready.body: Tap to review the steps before you apply.

slot_start.title: Time to start your routine
slot_start.body: Your slot just opened. Mark each step as you go.

recording_reminder.title: How did your routine go?
recording_reminder.body: Record what you applied so the rest of today knows what to build on.

page.title: Today's Suggestion
page.errorTitle: We could not load today's plan
page.error: Something went wrong loading your suggestions. You can try again.
page.normalRoutineRestored: Normal routine restored for future suggestions.
page.routineBreakStarted: Routine paused. No new suggestions will be generated until you resume.
page.routineBreakResumed: Routine resumed. Suggestions will appear when each slot approaches.
page.routineBreakActionFailed: We couldn't update your routine break. Please try again.

routineBreak.title: You're on a routine break
routineBreak.body: Ritora will keep your schedule intact, pause new suggestions, and stop routine reminders until you resume.

routineBreakStart.title: Take a routine break
routineBreakStart.body: Your schedule stays intact, but Ritora will pause new suggestions, routine reminders, and missed-routine backfill.
routineBreakStart.resumeDateHint: Optional. Leave blank to pause until you resume manually.

lockedDay.leadTitle: Suggestions arrive a couple of hours before each slot
lockedDay.leadBody: Your routine is being prepared in the background using last night's photo, your shelf, and your skin profile. It will appear here once the visibility window opens.
lockedDay.notifyTitle: You will get a heads up when it is ready
lockedDay.notifyBody: We send a notification when each slot becomes visible, again at the scheduled time, and a recording reminder. Manage all of this in <link>Notifications</link>.

slot.lockedExplainer: We only show suggestions a couple of hours before the slot so they reflect your latest photo, sleep, and check-in.
slot.generatingExplainer: Ritora is preparing this slot with your latest schedule, shelf, skin profile, and recent records.
slot.failedExplainer: This suggestion could not be prepared. It stays visible so the issue does not disappear from the day.
slot.missedExplainer: This slot passed without a saved application record. You can still record or edit it from History after today.

reactionBanner.title: Possible reaction in this morning's photo

tooltips.remove: Remove this product from the record

addProduct.title: Add a product I used
addProduct.body: Search your shelf or type a name
addProduct.panelBody: Choose an active shelf product or add a one-time off-shelf item.

substitution.reasonPlaceholder: Why did you substitute? For example, irritation, finished product, or texture.

recordSheet.notesPlaceholder: Anything Ritora should remember? For example, it stung a little near the cheek.
recordSheet.editReasonPlaceholder: Helpful so AI can learn. For example, ran out of product, or wrong product earlier.
recordSheet.recordLegal: You can edit this anytime. Every change is timestamped.

editHistory.willMarkAsEdited: This record will be marked as
editHistory.versionsAreKept: Every prior version is kept, so we never recommend something based on a changed record. You can review older versions on the day's History page.

reminderBanner.title: Record your {time} routine
reminderBanner.body: This slot is ready to log. Recording what actually happened keeps afternoon and evening suggestions accurate.
reminderBanner.skippedNote: Marked skipped from Today's Suggestion reminder.

detailDrawer.title: {daypart}, {time}

sections.intent: What I am trying to do
sections.whatISkipped: What I skipped today and why

detailDrawer.noRationale: No rationale captured for this suggestion.

skinProfile.title: Tell us about your skin first
skinProfile.body: We need your skin type, concerns, and goal before we can suggest anything safely. The setup takes about three minutes.
skinProfile.privacy: Encrypted at rest. Only Ritora's own AI suggestion engine reads it.

shelf.title: Add a few products to your shelf
shelf.body: Suggestions only use products you actually own. Take a photo of the bottle and its label, and Ritora pulls the brand, ingredients, and how to use it.
shelf.note: You can add as many as you want. Active, finished, and wishlist all count.

schedule.title: Build your weekly rhythm
schedule.body: Tell Ritora when you usually do your morning and evening routine. Suggestions only appear ahead of each scheduled slot.
schedule.ctaEveryDay: Apply one time to every day
schedule.note: You can change times anytime from Schedule.

recoverable.title: Nothing scheduled for now
recoverable.body: Your next slot today is at {nextSlotLabel}. While you wait, log a photo so the AI has fresh data when it generates.

page.title: History
page.subtitle: Past suggestions and what you actually applied. Edit any record anytime.
page.error: Something went wrong loading your history. You can try again.
page.exportError: We couldn't export your history. Try again.

filters.rangeInvalid: End date must be on or after the start date.

day.errorTitle: We could not load this day
day.error: Something went wrong loading this day. You can try again.
day.subtitle: {slots} slots, {applied} of {total} applied

compare.suggestedPlaceholder: Detail loading from the day's record.
compare.appliedPlaceholder: Detail loading from the day's record.
compare.noSuggested: No suggested steps were returned for this slot.
compare.noApplied: No application record has been saved for this slot.

day.outcomeNote: Outcome insights use what you actually applied, not what was suggested.
day.aiSawContext: This is the same record your AI saw when learning from this day.

empty.title: Nothing in history yet
empty.body: Past suggestions and what you applied appear here once a day completes. Edit any record anytime.

compare.title: Suggested next to applied
compare.body: Each past slot shows the routine we suggested next to the one you actually applied, so you can spot patterns over time.

editAnytime.title: Edit a record anytime
editAnytime.body: Forgot to record yesterday? Add it now. Used a different product than you logged? Change it. Every edit is timestamped and the original is kept.

insights.title: Insights and adherence
insights.body: With a few weeks of records, Ritora highlights patterns like products you regularly skip and how your skin responds.

losingData.q: Will I lose data if I edit a record?
losingData.a: No. We keep every prior version, so future suggestions never silently rely on a changed record.

whenItShows.q: When does today's suggestion show up here?
whenItShows.a: When the calendar date rolls over in your time zone. Until then, today stays on the Today's Suggestion page.

export.a: Yes, with the Export button. Hand it to a dermatologist or keep a copy.

patternNotice.title: Pattern noticed
patternNotice.body: Your adherence is at {percent}% across this period. Want me to adapt next week's plan based on what you actually apply most?
